Dear {{{Case.First_Name__c}}},
Thank you for contacting us!
We are writing to confirm that your return request your item(s) on order {{{Case.Order_Number__c}}} has been accepted. To proceed, please follow the instructions below:
Return Instructions:
- Return ID:
Your return ID is {{{Case.CaseNumber}}}. - Documentation:
Include a copy of your invoice or a note with your return ID and contact information inside the package. - Product Condition:
Returned products must be unopened and carefully packed. A restocking fee may apply if the products are returned damaged. - Refund Processing Time:
Refunds may take 2–3 weeks after we receive your returned items. If you do not see the refund after 3 weeks, please contact us. - Return Address:
Hsu’s Ginseng Return Dept.
237895 County Road W
Wausau, WI 54403 USA
If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to reply to this email or contact us at 1-800-826-1577.
Warm Regards
Customer Support Team
Hsu's Ginseng Enterprises, Inc.
